versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

Stack Exchange API skill v1.0.0 – initial release:

- Integrates Stack Exchange API with managed OAuth via ClawLink.
- Search, retrieve, and analyze questions, answers, comments, tags, and user activity across all Stack Exchange sites.
- Supports browsing tags, tracking user reputation, listing collectives, and analyzing community patterns.
- All operations are read-only for questions, answers, posts, comments, badges, tags, user profiles, and collectives.
- No API keys required; authentication is handled via the ClawLink dashboard.
